typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFile as string (),
	ArchiveFile_PA as string (),
	ArchivePath as string (),
	EmailRecipients as string (),
	EmailRecipientsCC as string (),
	EnvironmentCode as string (),
	ErrorEmailRecipients as string (),
	ErrorEmailRecipientsCC as string (),
	ErrorFile as string (),
	ErrorFileName as string (),
	ErrorPath as string (),
	FileLayoutCD as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	FileName_PA as string (),
	File_IID as integer (),
	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportFile_PA as string (),
	ImportPath as string (),
	MarketID as string (),
	RecordsImported as integer (),
	RecordsInSrcFile as integer (),
	RecordsWithLongMemberId as integer (),
	TimeStamp as string ()
}

source(output(
		MemberID as string,
		AuthID as string,
		AuthStatus as string,
		ProviderID as string,
		UrgentIndicator as string,
		ServiceLine as string,
		ReceivedDate as string,
		FromDate as string,
		ToDate as string,
		AUTHTYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sort(asc(MemberID, false),asc(AuthID, false),asc(ProviderID, false),asc(UrgentIndicator, false),asc(AUTHTYPE, false)) ~> RemoveDuplicates
RemoveDuplicates window(over(MemberID,
		AuthID,
		ProviderID,
		UrgentIndicator,
		AUTHTYPE),
	asc(MemberID, true),
	asc(AuthID, true),
	asc(ProviderID, true),
	asc(UrgentIndicator, true),
	asc(AUTHTYPE, true),
	Rank_col = rowNumber()) ~> RemoveDuplicatesdistinct
RemoveDuplicatesdistinct filter(Rank_col == 1) ~> RemoveDuplicatesdistinctFilterComponent
RemoveDuplicatesdistinctFilterComponent derive(FileIID = $File_IID,
		MEMBERNUMBER = MemberID + '00',
		CREATE_DATE = currentTimestamp(),
		Status = 'Partial Approved',
		Market_CD = toString($MarketID)) ~> AddFileIdandMemberNumber
AddFileIdandMemberNumber sink(input(
		UMPreCert_AuthID as string,
		UMPreCert_CREATE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		URGENT as string,
		UMPreCert_AUTH_STATUS as string,
		UMPreCert_PROVIDERID as string,
		UMPreCert_AUTH_TYPE as string,
		UMPreCert_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		FILEIMPORT_IID as integer,
		UMPreCert_MARKET_CD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		UMPreCert_AuthID = AuthID,
		UMPreCert_CREATE_DATE = CREATE_DATE,
		URGENT = UrgentIndicator,
		UMPreCert_AUTH_STATUS = Status,
		UMPreCert_PROVIDERID = ProviderID,
		UMPreCert_AUTH_TYPE = AUTHTYPE,
		UMPreCert_MEMBERNUMBER = MEMBERNUMBER,
		FILEIMPORT_IID = FileIID,
		UMPreCert_MARKET_CD = Market_CD)) ~> PDSUMPreCertInbound
